Learned counsel for the appellant submits that on 27/8/2024 regular application for grant of bail was filed before the trial Court but the same was dismissed hence this criminal appeal has been filed against that order of the Govind Paliwal vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 11 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/152334228/
1 trial Court approximately after a period of three months.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is submitted that in between the appellant has completed almost 7 months of custody.

The allegation against the appellant is regarding committing of rape with the prosecutrix and also of immoral trafficking but it is pertinent to mention that on the same FIR of the same prosecutrix another case was registered against some persons in Crime No.13/2023 in Harda police station wherein the accused Rafique Khan and Mahendra Soni have been released by the Coordinate Bench of this Court at principal seat, Jabalpur.
In that case the accused persons have been released on bail by filing no objection on behalf of the prosecutrix.
It is alleged that prosecutrix is inclined only to extort money from the accused persons.
The appellant has already completed 7 months of custody hence it is submitted that appeal filed by the appellant for grant of bail be allowed.
5. Learned counsel for respondent/State opposed the prayer for grant of bail submitting that in view of the allegation levelled against the appellant, he is not entitled to be released on bail.

6 . Heard the learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.
7.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case and also the fact that other co-accused persons against whom the same allegations have been levelled have already been released on bail, so also the fact that the appellant is in jail since 24/4/2024, I deem it fit to allow the appeal filed by the NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-IND:31876 3 CRA-10799-2024 appellant for grant of bail.

The appellant is directed to be released on bail upon his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the Court concerned during trial and shall also abide by the conditions enumerated under Section 437 (3) Cr.P.C.
8.
This order shall be effective till the end of the trial, however, in case of bail jump, it shall become ineffective.
